## Walkthrough

Renames `TerminationGracePeriodSeconds` to `TerminationGracePeriod` on `JobWrapper` in the RayJob test helper, adds an equivalent `TerminationGracePeriod` fluent method to `ServiceWrapper` in the RayService test helper, and updates all e2e test builder chains across singlecluster, multikueue, and TAS suites to use the new API.

## Changes

**Ray wrapper TerminationGracePeriod API and test updates**

| Layer / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **TerminationGracePeriod fluent API on JobWrapper and ServiceWrapper** <br> `pkg/util/testingjobs/rayjob/wrappers.go`, `pkg/util/testingjobs/rayservice/wrappers.go` | `JobWrapper.TerminationGracePeriodSeconds` is renamed to `TerminationGracePeriod`; `ServiceWrapper` gains a new `TerminationGracePeriod` method that propagates the value to the head group and all worker group pod templates. |
| **E2E tests updated to call TerminationGracePeriod(1)** <br> `test/e2e/singlecluster/extended/kuberay_test.go`, `test/e2e/multikueue/extended/e2e_test.go`, `test/e2e/tas/extended/rayjob_test.go` | All affected RayJob and RayService builder chains replace `TerminationGracePeriodSeconds(int64(1))` with `TerminationGracePeriod(1)` or add the call where it was missing. |

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 1 (Trivial) | ⏱️ ~3 minutes

## Poem

> 🐇 A name too long, a name reborn,
> `TerminationGracePeriod` — now trimmed and shorn!
> The service wrapper joins the fun,
> With `TerminationGracePeriod` for everyone.
> Hop hop, the tests all fall in line,
> Clean fluent chains now gleam and shine! ✨

</details>
